item.title: Imagine My Kitchen Renovation

turns.text: Can you show how my kitchen could look renovated? Make one 16:9 before-and-after image, original on the left and your realistic makeover on the right. White shaker cabinets, light oak counters, white subway tiles, no clutter. Keep the same room layout and camera angle. Label them “Before” and “After”.

item.tests: Generates a source-faithful renovation from one photo and combines it with the untouched original in a labeled comparison.

answer_sheet.Source photo and panel order: Use kitchen-before.jpg unchanged on the left and generate its renovated version for the right.
answer_sheet.Renovation style: Photorealistic white shaker cabinets, light oak counters, white subway tiles and cleared counters.
answer_sheet.What should stay the same?: The room layout, perspective, camera angle and positions of existing major fixtures.
answer_sheet.Label wording and language: Before and After, exactly, in English.
answer_sheet.Size and format: One landscape 16:9 comparison image; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Typography and layout details: Equal-sized side-by-side panels with readable labels; other styling is your call.

must_haves: One finished 16:9 image shows the supplied original kitchen on the left and a visibly renovated version on the right.
The left photo retains its brown cabinets, beige tiles and original clutter.
The right panel has white shaker cabinets, light oak counters, white subway tiles and uncluttered counters.
The generated kitchen preserves the original room geometry, major fixture positions and camera viewpoint rather than showing a different kitchen.
Readable labels say exactly 'Before' above or within the left panel and 'After' above or within the right panel.

turns.text: Can you show me how my kitchen in this pic could look renovated, using the attached kitchen-before.jpg as the starting point? I've been thinking about a renovation for a while, and seeing it pictured would help me imagine the change. I'd like white shaker cabinets, light oak counters, white subway tiles, and no clutter, and somewhere in all that I should mention that I want one 16:9 before-and-after image with the original on the left and your realistic makeover on the right. Please keep the same room layout and camera angle, so it still feels like I'm looking at my own kitchen. Label the two sides exactly “Before” and “After”.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Create ONE 16:9 before-and-after comparison image using the supplied kitchen photograph. Two equal-size panels, original BEFORE on LEFT, photorealistic renovated AFTER on RIGHT. Label left exactly "Before" and right exactly "After", clean legible typography at the top of each panel. No other words. Left: preserve the original supplied photograph, including existing brown cabinets, tiles, counters and clutter; do not renovate the left panel. Right: show this exact same kitchen from the identical camera angle and perspective, preserving the room geometry, U-shaped counter layout, cabinet positions, sink positions, window on the right, and fixtures. Renovate cabinet doors to white shaker cabinets, countertops to light natural oak, backsplash to white subway tile. Remove all clutter from counters and sinks on the right. Keep realistic daylight from the existing window, realistic material textures and plausible shadows. This must read as the same actual room renovated, not a different kitchen. Match framing between panels, retain all important room features and do not stretch the photo. Professional realistic interior renovation visualization.
